main_text.l: [illegible, ~20 letters] gne reliffi ... [illegible, ~30 letters] tes, Conjules exercitus contra[?] predtigarent, &
recepta ab Equit Comitiis, eandem exercere.
Tribuni, ut quanto bellum a tribunis [?]
decem Tribuni annui fierent, [illegible, ~40
letters] ftratibus suæ potestatis violatores, redilert s[?]
erent; Decemviri legibus scribendis perfectis,
imperitabant. Decemviri, principes sine provo-
catione facti, initis duodecim tabulis legibus,
potestate ad Tyrannidem, quam precipue Ap-
pius Claudius in Sociorum Decemvirum, [illegible, ~25
letters] tuta, sed fors pulchrè eximia, & Virginem filiam
Virginiam, (hanc ut ponerent, Cliuitium ruborem
vi qui puellam ex ancilla sua natam confirman-
do, amatore judice, in servitutem abstraheret)
exercere volebat, abusi, condolerent Magistra-
tum reducendi, ut ut subinde Tribuni mult-
um [?] potestate armaretur, occasionem de- [?]
tere. Consules reduxit, ut Romanus populum [?]
que obligaret, quod plebs tribunus tacere[?]
& negaret Magistratus sine provocationis
lege[?] ut, detinebat. Plebs, ut patriciorum & ple-
bis sanguine (?) tiuerent, & Tribuni milita-
res ex utrisque iterum ...
Sopus ... regnum per largitiones affec-
tans, à Cincinnato oppressus est. Fulvi-
us bellum moverat, nec sanae prior iplo-
rum exfictidi potestatem, quam Consules agerent.
Ibidem Sylvanus Ludem a Thucidide
quendam sub nomine Tiburnii (quo nam) legibus Ciuitatem ...
[illegible, ~20 letters] ut Chamada) restaurandi Brutus ... [illegible, ~15 letters] ... Tumultum ...

page.notes: Heavily damaged and faded page; many words illegible or doubtful. Marginal reference numbers in left margin (e.g. 3.3 etc.) partly unreadable. Transcription of the Latin is approximate; the text is from Tacitus, Annales Lib. II (ch. 27–28 region) and should be checked against the scan.
